svg.title: Assign Sequence
svg.desc: Assign Sequence Define the execution order of the welding process. Allows the user to organize workstations, robots, and weld trajectories into a logical execution sequence before running the welding simulation. Execution Order: Defines the order in which the welding operations will be performed. Process Organization: Structures Positions, Robots, and Welds according to the manufacturing plan. Simulation Preparation: Creates the sequence required before the robotic welding simulation is executed.
